subject: Animation
title: Family Guy and the Cutaway Revolution
description: One-minute skill: Family Guy and the Cutaway Revolution.

hook.text: Family Guy was canceled twice before DVD sales convinced Fox to bring it back from the dead.

buildup.text: Seth MacFarlane's show popularized the cutaway gag — random flashback jokes unrelated to the main plot.

discovery.text: The cutaway style divided critics but attracted a young male audience that made it a ratings hit.

twist.text: Family Guy's resurrection via DVD sales was unprecedented. It changed how networks evaluated canceled shows.

climax.text: The show proved that fan demand could overrule network decisions in the age of home media.

punchline.text: DVD sales brought a dead cartoon back to life twice.

quiz.question: How did Family Guy return after being canceled?
options: A different network picked it up
Strong DVD sales proved audience demand, convincing Fox to revive the show
